Identities:
# Identities
## What the theme covers
Personal attributes, personal relationships, eating and drinking, and physical well-being.

## Useful language
Describe people with être and avoir: il est grand, elle a les yeux bleus. Make adjectives agree: un ami sportif, une amie sportive. Say what you like with j’aime, j’adore and je déteste.

## Key terms
la famille: family
le caractère: personality, what someone is like
la santé: health, how well your body is
la nourriture: food, what people eat
j’aime: I like, I enjoy
Experiences:
# Experiences
## What the theme covers
Daily routine, leisure, holidays, festivals and celebrations.

## Useful language
Use reflexive verbs for routine: je me lève, je me douche. Talk about the past with the passé composé: je suis allé à la plage, j’ai mangé une crêpe. Use time markers: d’abord, ensuite, puis, le soir.

## Key terms
la routine quotidienne: daily routine
les loisirs: leisure, free time
les vacances: holidays
la fête: festival, party
se lever: to get up
Human ingenuity:
# Human ingenuity
## What the theme covers
Transport, entertainment, media and technology.

## Useful language
Compare with plus que and moins que: le train est plus rapide que le bus. Give opinions: je pense que le portable est utile parce que... Talk about frequency: toujours, souvent, jamais.

## Key terms
les transports: transport, ways of travelling
la technologie: technology, digital tools and devices
le portable: mobile phone, smartphone
les réseaux sociaux: social media, apps for sharing online
utile: useful, helpful for a purpose
Social organization:
# Social organization
## What the theme covers
Neighbourhood, education, the workplace and social issues.

## Useful language
Describe places with il y a: dans mon quartier il y a un parc. Talk about school subjects and future plans with aller + infinitive: je vais étudier la médecine.

## Key terms
le quartier: neighbourhood, the area where you live
le lycée: secondary school for older students
le travail: work, a job someone does
la matière: school subject such as maths
aller + infinitif: going to do something
Sharing the planet:
# Sharing the planet
## What the theme covers
Climate, physical geography, the environment and global issues.

## Useful language
Talk about weather with il fait and il y a: il fait chaud, il y a du brouillard. Give advice with il faut and on doit: il faut recycler; on doit économiser l’eau.

## Key terms
l’environnement: the environment, the natural world
le climat: climate, the usual weather of a place
recycler: to recycle, to reuse materials
la pollution: pollution, harmful waste in air or water
il faut: one must, it is necessary to
Paper 1: writing:
# Paper 1: writing
## The task
Paper 1 asks for short written texts in different text types, such as an email, a blog post, a diary entry or an informal letter. Choose the right register: informal for friends, formal for official readers.

## Doing it well
Answer every part of the task, organize ideas with connectors, use a range of tenses and check spelling and agreement.

## Key terms
le registre: register, formal or informal language
le type de texte: text type, such as an email or a blog
les connecteurs: linking words that organize ideas
la formule de politesse: polite formula at the end of a letter
Paper 2: listening and reading:
# Paper 2: listening and reading
## The task
Paper 2 tests understanding of audio and written texts on the themes. Questions include multiple choice, true or false with justification, and short answers.

## Doing it well
Read the questions before listening, look for key words and synonyms, and copy exact words from the text when justifying.

## Key terms
vrai: true, correct according to the text
faux: false, not correct according to the text
la justification: justification, the words that prove the answer
le synonyme: synonym, a word with the same meaning
Individual oral:
# Individual oral
## The task
The individual oral starts with a short presentation of a visual stimulus linked to a theme, followed by a conversation with the teacher.

## Doing it well
Describe the image, link it to the theme and to the target culture, give opinions with reasons, and keep the conversation going with questions.

## Key terms
l’image: the image, the picture
au premier plan: in the foreground
à l’arrière-plan: in the background
à mon avis: in my opinion
